findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 28 requests to 6 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 3.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 593 kB (16%) came from third-party domains, 103 kB of it from services classified as tracking (8 requests).

3 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
4 cookies were set by third-party domains (19 cookies in total).
